id.description: Unique base ID for the heading and content.

title.description: Content of the accordion heading button.

content.description: Content of the accordion panel. Ignored when children is provided.

children.description: Content of the accordion panel. Takes precedence over content when provided.

headingAs.description: Heading element wrapping the button. In Accordion, the parent controls this value.

headingClassName.description: Additional heading classes. In Accordion, the parent controls this value.

contentClassName.description: Additional panel classes. In Accordion, the parent controls this value.

handleToggle.description: React click handler for the heading button.

django.description: Callbacks cannot be rendered by Django.
